_disclaimer: All questions below are ORIGINAL practice content modeled on the TOEIC L&R format. They are NOT real ETS / TOEIC questions and contain no copyrighted content from the official exam.
_format: Each question has an id, sectionId (matching structure.ts), prompt (and audioPrompt where Listening uses audio in the real exam — we use text proxies in shell), choices (4 for parts 1, 3-7; 3 for part 2), correctIndex, explanation_en, explanation_vi. Difficulty is one of easy|medium|hard.

questions.imageHint: A man in a hardhat is reading a clipboard at a construction site.
questions.audioPrompt: Listen to four statements about the photo and choose the one that best describes it.
choices: A man is reading a document at a worksite.
A man is operating a machine.
A man is taking a photograph.
A man is climbing a ladder.
questions.explanation_en: Choice (A) describes the visible action — reading. The other choices describe activities not shown.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án (A) mô tả hành động thấy được trong tranh — đang đọc. Các lựa chọn còn lại mô tả việc không có trong tranh.

questions.imageHint: A woman is handing a paper bag across a counter to a customer.
questions.audioPrompt: Listen to four statements about the photo.
choices: She's handing something to a customer.
questions.explanation_en: (B) matches the visible exchange. Watch for present-continuous verbs that describe what's happening RIGHT NOW.
questions.explanation_vi: (B) khớp với hành động đang diễn ra. Chú ý động từ thì hiện tại tiếp diễn — diễn tả hành động đang xảy ra.

questions.audioPrompt: Where did you put the report?
choices: On your desk, next to the laptop.
questions.explanation_en: The question asks WHERE — only (B) gives a location. (A) answers WHEN, (C) is a comment about the report.
questions.explanation_vi: Câu hỏi WHERE (ở đâu) — chỉ (B) cho biết vị trí. (A) trả lời WHEN (khi nào), (C) là nhận xét về bản báo cáo.

questions.audioPrompt: Should we order more printer paper, or do we still have enough?
choices: Let me check the supply closet first.
The printer is on the second floor.
questions.explanation_en: The 'or' question is asking the responder to decide — (A) is the natural action-first answer. The classic Vietnamese learner trap is picking (B) because it shares vocabulary ('printer').
questions.explanation_vi: Câu hỏi 'or' yêu cầu người nghe quyết định — (A) là câu trả lời hành động hợp lý. Bẫy hay gặp với người Việt là chọn (B) vì có từ chung ('printer').

questions.audioPrompt:
Conversation between a hotel guest and a front-desk clerk:
— Hi, I booked a quiet room facing the garden, but mine faces the parking lot.
— I apologize, sir. Let me check what we have available… I can move you to room 412 — same rate, garden view, ready in 20 minutes.
— That works. Should I leave my key at the desk?
— Yes, just drop it here whenever you're ready.

questions.explanation_en: Listen for the contrast 'but mine faces the parking lot' — the issue is the view, not size or price.
questions.explanation_vi: Nghe sự đối lập 'but mine faces the parking lot' — vấn đề là view, không phải kích thước hay giá.

choices: A different room at the same rate.
questions.explanation_en: 'Same rate, garden view' — the clerk's offer matches the guest's original booking, no upgrade or refund.
questions.explanation_vi: 'Same rate, garden view' — đề nghị của lễ tân khớp với đặt phòng ban đầu, không nâng cấp hay hoàn tiền.

questions.audioPrompt:
Voicemail message:
'Hi Mai, this is David from Logistics. The Tuesday shipment was rerouted because of the storm — it's now landing Thursday at the latest. I've already emailed the customer with an apology and a 5% credit on the next invoice. Call me back if you'd rather we offer a full refund instead. Thanks.'

questions.prompt: What is the main reason for David's call?
choices: To ask Mai to call the customer.
To explain a shipment delay and the action he took.
questions.explanation_en: David explains the delay AND the action taken (email + 5% credit). 'Action taken' framing is common in TOEIC voicemail items.
questions.explanation_vi: David giải thích sự chậm trễ VÀ hành động đã làm (email + giảm 5%). Cấu trúc 'action taken' rất hay gặp trong voicemail TOEIC.

questions.prompt: The conference call has been ____ until next Tuesday because of the network outage.
questions.explanation_en: After 'has been' we need a past participle (passive). 'Postponed' is the only past participle here.
questions.explanation_vi: Sau 'has been' cần past participle (bị động). 'Postponed' là dạng past participle duy nhất.

questions.prompt: Employees who registered ____ the wellness program will receive a reminder email.
questions.explanation_en: 'Register FOR' is the fixed collocation. Vietnamese learners often default to 'register to' (matching 'đăng ký TỚI'), which is incorrect in English.
questions.explanation_vi: 'Register FOR' là collocation cố định. Người Việt hay nhầm 'register to' theo cấu trúc 'đăng ký TỚI' — không đúng trong tiếng Anh.

questions.prompt: ____ his recent promotion, Mr. Tran continues to handle the day-to-day operations of the department.
questions.explanation_en: 'Despite' is a preposition followed by a noun phrase ('his recent promotion'). 'Although' would need a clause. 'However' is a conjunctive adverb requiring a different sentence shape.
questions.explanation_vi: 'Despite' là giới từ đi với cụm danh từ ('his recent promotion'). 'Although' phải đi với mệnh đề. 'However' là trạng từ liên kết cần cấu trúc khác.

questions.prompt:
From: facilities@maple-corp.example
To: all-staff@maple-corp.example
Subject: Office cleaning schedule

Starting next month, our cleaning service will visit twice ____ (1) week instead of three times. The reduction reflects ____ (2) cost-saving initiative announced in the last quarterly meeting. ____ (3). If you have personal items at your desk, please secure them before leaving on Wednesday evenings.

Question: choose the best fill for blank (3).
choices: Cleaning will now happen Monday and Thursday after 6 PM.
The cleaning service has been with us for ten years.
Most staff prefer carpeted floors over wood.
Our wellness benefits will not change.
questions.explanation_en: (A) supplies the missing logistical detail (when) and explains why personal items need to be secured. The other choices are unrelated.
questions.explanation_vi: (A) cung cấp chi tiết hậu cần còn thiếu (thời gian) và giải thích vì sao cần cất đồ cá nhân. Các lựa chọn còn lại không liên quan.

questions.passage:
Notice posted on a coffee-shop wall:

'Reward Card holders — starting June 1, your loyalty points will roll over month to month for up to 90 days. Previously, points expired at the end of each calendar month. The new 90-day window applies automatically; no action is required. Note that double-points Wednesdays will continue under the same rules. Any unused points from May will be added to your June balance.'

questions.prompt: What is the main change announced?
choices: Loyalty points will last longer before expiring.
Wednesdays no longer offer double points.
The store is closing in June.
questions.explanation_en: The lead sentence states points 'will roll over month to month for up to 90 days' — that's the main change.
questions.explanation_vi: Câu mở đầu cho biết điểm 'will roll over month to month for up to 90 days' — đó là thay đổi chính.

questions.prompt: Do customers need to do anything to activate the new rule?
choices: Yes, opt in via the store's website.
No, the new window applies automatically.
questions.explanation_en: 'No action is required' = 'applies automatically'. Watch for paraphrase, not exact-match wording.
questions.explanation_vi: 'No action is required' = 'applies automatically'. Chú ý paraphrase, không phải khớp từng chữ.
